arabic: دع لذيذ الكرى وانتبه ثم صل واستقم في الدجى وابتهل ثم قل
english: Leave your comfortable sleep and wake up. Pray, stand in the quiet night, raise your hands in prayer, and say:

arabic: يا مجيب الدعا يا عظيم الجلال يا لطيف بنا دايم لم يزل
english: O One who answers our prayers, O Lord of great majesty, You have always been kind and gentle to us.

arabic: دع لذيذ الكرى وانتبه ثم صل واستقم في الدجى وابتهل ثم قل
english: Leave your comfortable sleep and wake up. Pray, stand in the quiet night, raise your hands in prayer, and say:

arabic: يا مجيب الدعا يا عظيم الجلال يا لطيف بنا دايم لم يزل
english: O One who answers our prayers, O Lord of great majesty, You have always been kind and gentle to us.

arabic: واحد ماجد قابض باسط حاكم عادل كل ما شا فعل
english: You are the One and Most Glorious, the One who gives and withholds. You are the Just Ruler who does whatever You will.

arabic: ظاهر باطن حافظ رافع سامع عالم ما بحكمه ميل
english: You are seen and unseen, our Protector and the One who raises us. You hear and know everything, and Your judgment is always just.

arabic: أول آخر ليس له منتهى جل ما له شريك ولا له مثل
english: You are the First and the Last, with no end. You are far above all things; You have no partner and nothing is like You.

arabic: بعد لطفك بنا ربنا افعل بنا كل ما أنت له يا إلهي أهل
english: Our Lord, You have always shown us kindness. Treat us with the mercy and goodness that only You can give.

arabic: يا مجيب الدعا يا متم الرجا أسألك بالذي يا إلاهي نزل
english: O One who answers prayers and fulfils our hopes, I ask You by the One through whom, O my Lord, the revelation was sent down.

arabic: به على المصطفى مع شديد القوى واسألك بالذي دك صلب الجبل
english: The revelation brought to the Chosen Prophet by the mighty angel. I also ask You by the One who can crush even the strongest mountain.

arabic: الغنى والرضا والهدى والتقى والعفو.. العفو ثم حسن العمل
english: Grant me contentment, a life free from need, guidance, and piety. Forgive me again and again, and help me do good deeds.

arabic: واسألك غادي مادي كلما لج فيه الرعد حل فينا الوجل
english: I ask You by the clouds that move across the sky, as thunder roars and fills our hearts with awe.

arabic: وادق صادق غادق ضاحك باكي كلما ضحك مزنه هطل
english: I ask You by the clouds that gather and pour down rain, as the sky opens and showers fall upon the earth.

arabic: المحث المرث المحن المرن هامي سامي داني متصل
english: The clouds gather high above, then move closer and closer, pouring down rain without stopping.

arabic: به يحط الحصا بالوطا من علا منحني بالرفا والغثا بالشلل
english: The rain carries pebbles down from the hills, bends the branches, and sweeps away the debris with rushing water.

arabic: أسألك بعد ذا عارض سايح كن به طق مثنى سحابه طبل
english: I ask You by the great rain clouds that spread across the sky, their thunder beating like drums.

arabic: داير حاير عارض رايح كل من شاف برقه تخاطف جفل
english: The storm clouds swirl and sweep across the sky. Whoever sees their lightning is startled by its sudden flash.

arabic: من سحاب حقوق صدوق جفول عريض مريض وني عجل
english: Huge clouds gather across the sky, restless and heavy, moving quickly as the storm draws near.

arabic: كن مزنه إلى ما ارتدم وارتكم في مثاني السدى دامرات الحلل
english: The rain clouds pile up layer upon layer, covering the sky with thick, dark clouds.

arabic: ناشي غاشي سداه فوق السها كن مقدم سحابه يجرجر عجل
english: The clouds rise and spread, hiding the distant stars as the leading clouds pull the rest quickly behind them.

arabic: مدهش مرهش مرعش منعش كن به لمع هند بكون تسل
english: The mighty storm fills us with awe, while flashes of lightning shine like the sharp blade of a sword.

arabic: أدهمٍ مظلمٍ موجف مركم جورسيله يعم الوعر والسهل
english: Dark clouds gather into a mighty storm, sending rushing waters across the hills and open plains.

arabic: كلما إختفق واصطفق واندفق إستهل وانتهل وانهمل كالهلل
english: The winds blow, the clouds clash, and the water rushes down as heavy rain pours from the sky.

arabic: به يحط الحصى بالوطا من علا منحني بالرفا والغثا بالشلل
english: The rain carries pebbles down from the hills, bends the branches, and sweeps away the debris with rushing water.

arabic: حينما إستوى وارتوى واقتوى إستقل وانتقل واضمحل المحل
english: The thirsty land drinks its fill and grows strong again. The waters recede, the clouds move on, and the drought comes to an end.

arabic: بعد ذا آخر ماض جورماه ثم يشيل الشجر في مسيل الفحل
english: As the last floodwaters rush past, they carry branches and trees along the river channels.

arabic: كلما إزدجر واندجر وانفجر ماه حط الحجر في جروف المحل
english: As the waters surge and burst through the land, they throw stones into the dry ravines.

arabic: والفياض اخصبت والرياض اعشبت والركايا ارعجت والمقل أسفهل
english: The valleys become fertile, the gardens turn green, the wells fill with water, and the dry land comes back to life.

arabic: والحزوم اربعت والجوازي سعت والطيور اسجعت فوق زهر النفل
english: The hills turn green, young gazelles roam freely, and birds sing sweetly above the blooming clover.

arabic: كن وصف اختلاف الزهر في الرياض إختلاف الفرش والزوالي تفل
english: The flowers bloom in many different colours, making the gardens look like beautiful carpets spread across the land.

arabic: يا مجيب الدعا يا متم الرجا إستجب دعوتي إنني مبتهل
english: O One who answers prayers and fulfils our hopes, please answer my prayer, for I call upon You with all my heart.
